title: Continental Shelf
definition: The continental shelf is the gently sloping, shallow extension of a continent submerged under relatively shallow seas and bays, marking the submerged edge of the continental landmass.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for both Geography (GS-1: Geomorphology, Oceanography, economic resources) and International Relations / Security (GS-2/3: UNCLOS, Exclusive Economic Zones, maritime security, energy security).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts, geomorphology, and bathymetry of the Continental Shelf.
Evaluate spatial distribution, UNCLOS legal frameworks, and geopolitical significance.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
